entries.title: Papers, Please

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it is the original complete desktop release with PC capture/settings flexibility. macOS, Linux, Vita, iPad, iPhone, and Android versions are documented access routes, but no sourced platform-exclusive story or case content over PC is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Papers, Please on Steam, GOG, Humble, or the official site for Windows PC and play the current desktop build.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2022 phone/mobile versions adapt the interface for smaller touch screens; the official LCD, Please demake is a separate browser entry rather than a port of the full game.

entries.title: LCD, Please

emulation.notes: Run the browser version from the official itch.io page.

primary.why: LCD, Please is an official free browser demake made for the tenth anniversary, so the web release is the complete and intended route.
primary.how_to_play: Play LCD, Please in a desktop web browser from the official Lucas Pope itch.io page.

entries.remaster_caveats: LCD, Please is a small demake/anniversary project and should be treated as a companion piece, not the definitive way to play Papers, Please.
